Report.title: Report
Report.description: AI-Ready Stock Analysis Research Report entity with raw data retention, vector embedding slot, change detection hash, and versioning.

id.description: Unique report identifier (e.g. rep_88888 or standard key)

reportTitle.description: Full title of the research report

rawDate.description: Original raw date string from portal (e.g. 26.01.02)

currentPrice.description: Market stock price at report publication time

pdfUrl.description: Direct download link for official PDF attachment

pdfStatus.description: Detailed PDF acquisition status (OBTAINED, MISSING_ORIGINAL, etc.)

bodyText.description: Extracted text content from web article body or PDF text

paragraphs.description: Structured paragraph array of report body content

characterCount.description: Character count of the report text

contentHash.description: SHA-256 hash of core report content for update-on-change detection

version.description: Monotonically incrementing schema version number for this record

firstSavedAt.description: ISO timestamp when record was first inserted into DB

lastUpdatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when record was last updated in DB

isAIAnalyzed.description: Whether AI deep analysis has been performed

aiSummary.description: AI-generated executive summary and core thesis

embeddingVector.description: Vector embedding coordinates (768-dim) for RAG semantic search

SyncLog.title: SyncLog
SyncLog.description: Audit log for database synchronization operations with change tracking metrics.

targetMonth.description: Target month or scope synced (e.g. 2026-01, ALL)

updatedCount.description: Number of records modified due to content changes

skippedCount.description: Number of unchanged records skipped to save writes

/reports/{reportId}.description: Collection of research reports stored with safe change-detection versioning and AI analysis fields.

/sync_logs/{syncLogId}.description: Collection of database synchronization batch audit records.
